hou.text: Bontu, the god of ambition, reveals she secretly helped Bolas conquer Amonkhet, betraying her plane and fellow gods.
She exploits Hazoret's compassion and drags her before the God-Pharaoh, and Bolas orders her to kill Hazoret, which she nearly does.
Then Bolas betrays and slays Bontu, and Hazoret breaks free with her faithful, becoming the only living god.
